text:
Nora: ran the silent-signal sweep for Orpheus11b-int6 last night. need a compact econ + risk blurb for GTN.
Ethan: upload is at s3://redwood/exp/4224678910. quick TL;DR below.
Samir: TL;DR please (per-100k tokens, p95, and key failure modes).
Ethan: baseline (prod 14b-int8) per-100k = $10.50, p95 = 330ms, multi-hop F1 = 0.912
Ethan: orpheus11b-int6 w/ targeted priming (+6% tokens) per-100k = $6.10, p95 = 355ms, multi-hop F1 = 0.901
Ethan: priming gives search recall +2.2% on short evidence retrieval. nominal savings ~42% before rerank.
Keiko: if we add a finalize/rerank on 3% of outputs net savings ~39%.
Nora: where are the quality hits? more hallucination or factual omission?
Ethan: mostly multi-hop factual chaining errors and missing intermediate facts in long synthesis (>700 tokens). extraction and short Q/A unaffected. Hallucinations rare but spike on list-of-facts prompts.
Samir: product asks for <0.008 absolute drop on multi-hop F1. Can routing + micro-finalize get us there?
Ethan: sim policy: length+evidence_count routing + cheap finalizer on low-conf -> recovers ~0.006 F1 if finalizer applied to ~4% of traffic. net savings ~36%.
Nora: routing proposal:
- short (<180 tokens OR evidence_count <=1): orpheus11b-int6 primary (90%), fallback 14b-int8 on low-confidence
- mid (181-600): orpheus primary (70%), fallback 14b (30%)
- complex (>600 OR evidence_count >3): 14b-int8 primary, orpheus drafts for latency then finalize when confidence low
Also enable small per-user KV warmstart for active retrieval sessions to bring p95 down.
Samir: add a cheap semantic-check rerank id `orph-rerank-lite` for canary. that flow costs ~0.003 / 1k tokens on sampled traffic.
Keiko: what's the monitoring and rollback thresholds for GTN?
Nora: flag `orpheus.int6.sweep.v1` canary: 2% -> 10% -> 40%. rollback triggers:
- multihop_F1_drop > 0.008 abs
- regen_rate > 1.6x
- p95 > 520ms or p95_increase > 1.6x
Also sample 0.2% to full-eval (human + synthetic) for 14 days.
Ethan: add A/B for priming intensity (6% vs 10%) to measure recall/token tradeoff. knob = `orpheus.int6.sweep.v1.priming_intensity`.
Samir: quick ops copy config (pasteable):
```json
{
  "flag": "orpheus.int6.sweep.v1",
  "routing": [
    {"max_len": 180, "primary": "orpheus11b-int6", "fallback": "14b-int8", "primary_weight": 0.9},
    {"min_len": 181, "max_len": 600, "primary": "orpheus11b-int6", "fallback": "14b-int8", "primary_weight": 0.7},
    {"min_len": 601, "primary": "14b-int8", "fallback": "orpheus11b-int6", "primary_weight": 1.0}
  ],
  "priming": {"extra_tokens_pct": 6},
  "rerank_flow": "orph-rerank-lite",
  "flags": ["orpheus.int6.sweep.v1"]
}
```
Keiko: good. ops note: please include counters for `evidence_count`, `confidence_score`, `struct_coherence`, `multihop_F1_sampled`. GTN wants those dashboards.
Ethan: simulation outputs attached show that applying finalizer to 4% of traffic yields multi-hop F1 drop of only 0.004 and net savings ~36%. details in the notebook.
Nora: schedule plan: ops PR + GTN one-pager by EOD tomorrow. Keiko, can you own the dashboard cards?
Keiko: yep will add per-route panels and a small alert rule for `multihop_F1_drop > 0.006` to start (we can tighten).
deploy-bot: scheduled: feature flag orpheus.int6.sweep.v1 -> 2% at 4224678950, healthchecks enabled.
Samir: small follow-up: let's reserve a tiny A/B arm (0.5%) to test orpheus11b-int6 with int4 quant (aggressive) for 24h to see coherence delta.
Nora: ok add `orpheus.int6.sweep.v1.aggressive_quant_test` for that micro-experiment post-canary.
Ethan: will run and post slices. closing loop.
Keiko: ack.
Nora: thanks team :thumbsup:
